quotes.name: Oversold Cemetery
quotes.flavor:
"Of course we can squeeze in a few more! It's not like corpses need personal space."
—Orson, cemetery baron

quotes.name: Enraged Huorn
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"They stand watching endlessly over the trees. It is difficult to see them moving, but they can move very quickly if they are angry."
—Merry

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, hill giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

quotes.name: Blast of Genius
quotes.flavor: Ral Zarek's brainstorms bring actual thunder and lightning.

quotes.name: Everett K. Ross, Hapless Attaché
quotes.flavor: Everett learned from his experiences escorting Wakandan royalty. This time he brought a bigger car and an extra pair of pants.

quotes.name: Veilstone Amulet
quotes.flavor: Sometimes it's ostentatious to go unseen.

quotes.name: Necrotic Sliver
quotes.flavor: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

quotes.name: Zuran Orb
quotes.flavor:
"Obsession is Zur's one flaw as a magic user. His total preoccupation with immortality has become an affliction for his otherwise brilliant mind."
—Jodah, Archmage Eternal

quotes.name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn's protection is everywhere. From the holy church to the sacred glade, all that we see is under her blessed watch."

quotes.name: Iron Lad, Young Avenger
quotes.flavor: "I'm from the Thirtieth Century. They call me Kang . . ."

quotes.name: Guiding Voice
quotes.flavor: When honormancers work together, their compliments are complementary.

quotes.name: Sonic Burst
quotes.flavor: Music scythes the savage beast.

quotes.name: Mana Geyser
quotes.flavor: The Quicksilver Sea hissed and bubbled at the indignity. The Vulshok shaman just smiled.

quotes.name: Tithing Blade // Consuming Sepulcher
quotes.flavor:
"Slake my thirst so that we both may be free."
—Faded inscription

quotes.name: Beguiler of Wills
quotes.flavor: "Come, let me free you of the tyranny of thought."

quotes.name: Crossroads Candleguide
quotes.flavor: Do the candleguides' heads turn to follow you as you pass, or is it merely a trick of the flickering light?

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: The erupting flames work as both barrier and weapon.

quotes.name: Tariel, Reckoner of Souls
quotes.flavor:
"After death you face paradise, damnation, or Tariel."
—Priest's teaching

quotes.name: Abyssal Harvester
quotes.flavor: Final moments stricken by terror make the corpses into potent magical fuel.

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: Once, the "Houses of Tomorrow." Now, the tombs of today.

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor:
"What are ramparts, what are steeples, what are our machines worth in the teeth of this ceaseless hunger?"
—Magos Varnak

quotes.name: Wrap in Vigor
quotes.flavor: Some nature mages unknowingly took advantage of the temporal energies still swirling on Dominaria. What they mistook for healing magic was in fact the manipulation of time.

quotes.name: Eater of Days
quotes.flavor: When Mirrodin's varied civilizations developed ways to fight the levelers, Memnarch upped the stakes.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rager
quotes.flavor:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: T'Pol, Vulcan Representative
quotes.flavor: "Humans needed the help of the Vulcans when they discovered warp drive. That need hasn't changed."

quotes.name: Manalith
quotes.flavor:
"Though the afterlife, the city, and even the God-Pharaoh himself were one great deception, the ideals championed by the gods remain true."
—Djeru, former Tah-crop initiate

quotes.name: Heckling Fiends
quotes.flavor: Their language may be a cacophonous agglomeration of chittering snorts and mad barking, but the message they send is all too clear.

quotes.name: Nivix Guildmage
quotes.flavor: "The only action worth taking is one with an unknown outcome."

quotes.name: Coordinated Maneuver
quotes.flavor:
"We follow the dragonstorms, and we take down any threats that emerge from them!"
—Zurgo, khan of the Mardu

quotes.name: Archmage Emeritus
quotes.flavor:
"If you are ever to become a capable astrologian, you must believe in the path laid out before you, and in your power to read it, follow it, and ultimately control it."
—Leveva Heavensreader

quotes.name: Reckless Embermage
quotes.flavor: Those who play with fire are bound to get burned.

quotes.name: Daybreak Combatants
quotes.flavor: After weeks of unending darkness, a glimpse of dawn was all the people of Stensia needed to rekindle their will to fight.

quotes.name: Merrow Levitator
quotes.flavor: He fancies himself a master thief, claiming to "steal the ground" from his victims.

quotes.name: Hazoret's Monument
quotes.flavor:
"The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle."
—Monument inscription

quotes.name: Harvester of Souls
quotes.flavor:
"He is judge, jury, and executioner because he killed them all."
—Bishop Cawle of Elgaud

quotes.name: Bloodtracker
quotes.flavor: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

quotes.name: Dreadhound
quotes.flavor: It herds souls toward eternal torment.

quotes.name: Pollen-Shield Hare // Hare Raising
quotes.flavor: She can drive off any threat, from owl to hunter to Phyrexian monster.

quotes.name: Cruel Finality
quotes.flavor: Bitter the bite of a demon's steel, and deep the abyss it opens.

quotes.name: Dancing Scimitar
quotes.flavor: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

quotes.name: Dual-Sun Adepts
quotes.flavor:
"You fight beside me as brilliantly as the dawn. I have nothing more to teach you."
—Master Iridiss

quotes.name: Goldenglow Moth
quotes.flavor: Las polillas comunes la siguen, atraídas por su luz.

quotes.name: Nantuko Cultivator
quotes.flavor: "Every seed holds strength and teaches patience."

quotes.name: Balduvian Horde
quotes.flavor:
"Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head."
—Lovisa Coldeyes, Balduvian chieftain

quotes.name: Reverse Damage
quotes.flavor:
"My enemy's hatred is his weakness. My enemy's anger is my strength."
—Remin, venerable monk

quotes.name: Spark Double
quotes.flavor: "I couldn't possibly make all of this mischief alone. Oh, hello there, handsome!"

quotes.name: Superior Foes of Spider-Man
quotes.flavor: Boomerang managed to assemble a squad that really wasn't all that sinister and certainly wasn't all that six.

quotes.name: Ahn-Crop Invader
quotes.flavor:
"Give me a crew like this one and I'd rule any sea I sailed."
—Angrath

quotes.name: Alpha Guard
quotes.flavor: "Whimsy overflow in sector G! The gremlins are rampaging and the beebles are on fire!"

quotes.name: Karplusan Hound
quotes.flavor:
"Don't worry, they don't bite. They much prefer setting people on fire."
—Jaya Ballard, to Chandra

quotes.name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout
quotes.flavor: "It's not a matter of what I know. It's a matter of making it worth my while to tell you."

quotes.name: Prying Eyes
quotes.flavor: "Citizen! Your crime has been recorded. Cease movement and await arrest, or further penalties will be immediately imposed."

quotes.name: Mox Emerald
quotes.flavor: 2015 Vintage Championship Winner

quotes.name: Merchant's Dockhand
quotes.flavor:
"If you can build it, we can move it."
—Bes Tavani, Bomat merchant

quotes.name: Flamewave Invoker
quotes.flavor: The Mirari burns in his heart.

quotes.name: Goblin Snowman
quotes.flavor:
"Strength in numbers? Right."
—Ib Halfheart, goblin tactician

quotes.name: Kurkesh, Onakke Ancient
quotes.flavor: The Onakke were masters of dark arts and artifice. Their creations continue to spread foul magic, paving the way for their return.

quotes.name: Languish
quotes.flavor: Life is such a fragile thing.

quotes.name: Deadshot
quotes.flavor:
"Carrion! Keep your distance. My blade will come to you!"
—Crovax

quotes.name: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma
quotes.flavor: You don't want to know how she got that name.

quotes.name: Wolverine Pack
quotes.flavor:
"Give them great meals of beef and iron and steel, they will eat like wolves and fight like devils."
—William Shakespeare, *King Henry V*

quotes.name: I Am Duskmourn
quotes.flavor: "I am infinite. All that you behold, even the stars above, are my domain."

quotes.name: Youthful Knight
quotes.flavor:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Grave Robbers
quotes.flavor:
"If you don't have your health, you don't have anything."
—Proverb

quotes.name: Shard of the Nightbringer
quotes.flavor:
"Aza'gorod, the Nightbringer. The embodiment of death. A killer of stars and of worlds."
—Illuminor Szeras

quotes.name: Fetid Heath
quotes.flavor:
"Do not linger in such places, child. There the gwyllions dance. If they find you, you will join in their revels for eternity."
—Talara, elvish safewright

quotes.name: Ripscale Predator
quotes.flavor: As Ravnica's wilds expanded, even advocates for nature had to confront fiercer natural threats.

quotes.name: Electrosiphon
quotes.flavor: "I calculate your chance of success to be . . . well, I don't want to be morbid . . ."

quotes.name: Acidic Slime
quotes.flavor: It fears no sword and leaves no bones behind.

quotes.name: Totally Lost
quotes.flavor: Fblthp had always hated crowds.

quotes.name: Beacon of Unrest
quotes.flavor: A vertical scream pierces the night air and echoes doom through the clouds.

quotes.name: Dauntless Scrapbot
quotes.flavor: The wastelands of yesterday's colonies will pave the road to tomorrow's.

quotes.name: Browbeat
quotes.flavor:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

quotes.name: Hamlet Captain
quotes.flavor: "I would fear this fight, bloodsucker, were I alone."

quotes.name: Eclipsed Steppe
quotes.flavor: The Arch Obscura never appears for the same eyes twice. Those who bear witness either find peace in their own insignificance or dread in the unnatural twilight.

quotes.name: Restore
quotes.flavor:
"See, the land itself raises an altar to the ascendancy of nature."
—Mayael the Anima

quotes.name: Mirror Entity
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, it sees only itself, reflected a thousand times over.

quotes.name: Alchemist's Refuge
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Persecuted alchemists fled deep into Kessig's wilds, seeking solitude to continue their ghoulish craft.

quotes.name: Ancient Cornucopia
quotes.flavor:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!"
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"What's so great about seeing a volcano? It's just a sort of leaky mountain."
—The Twelfth Doctor

quotes.name: Hero's Downfall
quotes.flavor: Destiny exalts a chosen few, but even heroes break.

quotes.name: Beetleback Chief
quotes.flavor: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

quotes.name: Marisi, Breaker of the Coil
quotes.flavor: "Cast off the law! Awaken your rage!"

quotes.name: Ardenvale Tactician // Dizzying Swoop
quotes.flavor: In a castle that prizes loyalty above all, the bond between knight and griffin is unmatched.

quotes.name: Frilled Sea Serpent
quotes.flavor:
"Reel it in. No, wait! Throw it back!"
—Gertrude, deep-sea angler

quotes.name: Soldevi Golem
quotes.flavor: Slow and steady wins the race.

quotes.name: Roon of the Hidden Realm
quotes.flavor: "Time and space are just new battlefields to be mastered."

quotes.name: Glory of Warfare
quotes.flavor: "Their hopes dashed on our shields! Their victory slashed by our swords!"

quotes.name: Kinsbaile Skirmisher
quotes.flavor: "If a boggart even dares breathe near one of my kin, I'll know. And I'll not be happy."

quotes.name: Candlelight Vigil
quotes.flavor: Selesnya guildmages do not sleep so the rest of the conclave can.

quotes.name: Giant Killer // Chop Down
quotes.flavor: "What size advantage? They never even see me coming."

quotes.name: Sidewinder Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"They encircled our patrol with the stealth of snakes, corralling us like livestock."
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

quotes.name: Explosive Apparatus
quotes.flavor:
"Souls are volatile things. When compressed and loaded into a handheld device, their destructive potential is quite impressive."
—Dierk, geistmage

quotes.name: Oildeep Gearhulk
quotes.flavor: Oil-actuated inventions raised eyebrows after the Invasion, but no one could argue against the efficacy of the design.

quotes.name: Palladium Myr
quotes.flavor: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

quotes.name: Bane of Progress
quotes.flavor: It sees shaped stone and carved wood as mutilations.

quotes.name: Mystical Tutor
quotes.flavor: "It's not just what you know. It's knowing where to find what you don't."

quotes.name: Razortide Bridge
quotes.flavor: The path to unity is forged in understanding.

quotes.name: Homestead Courage
quotes.flavor: "C'mon, fiend. I'll carve you up like a Harvesttide ham."

quotes.name: Reshape
quotes.flavor:
"Today's paperweight, tomorrow's leveler."
—Bruenna, Neurok leader

quotes.name: Beacon of Immortality
quotes.flavor: The cave floods with light. A thousand rays shine forth and meld into one.

quotes.name: Vexing Radgull
quotes.flavor: Fighting one is a terrible experience.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Universal Automaton
quotes.flavor:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor:
"I await your donation."
—Dasha, Orzhov priest

quotes.name: Plundering Predator
quotes.flavor: You can gather a tidy fortune if you can avoid getting clobbered by falling treasure.

quotes.name: Rathi Dragon
quotes.flavor: Wrap the flame as twine Kingdoms will be thine.

quotes.name: Destructive Urge
quotes.flavor: Red sky at night, dragon's delight.

quotes.name: Sulfuric Vortex
quotes.flavor: As the life drained out of Kratos, the arms of Hades reached out to claim their prize.

quotes.name: Devastation
quotes.flavor: There is much talk about the art of creation. What about the art of destruction?

quotes.name: Deny Existence
quotes.flavor: When all logical solutions fail, try an illogical one.

quotes.name: Boar Umbra
quotes.flavor: "From in here, everything looks like dinner."

quotes.name: Seaside Citadel
quotes.flavor: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

quotes.name: Blacksmith's Skill
quotes.flavor: Before he was subjugated by demonic forces, Dakkon was a master smith of unrivaled artistry.

quotes.name: Painful Truths
quotes.flavor: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

quotes.name: Urza's Power Plant
quotes.flavor: Artifact construction required immense resources.

quotes.name: Contradict
quotes.flavor: Those who question Ojutai may not like the answers they receive.

quotes.name: Reassembling Skeleton
quotes.flavor:
"If none of the bones are original, is it even the same skele—aaagh!"
—Mort the Philosopher, last words

quotes.name: Rat Colony
quotes.flavor: Wreckage from the Phyrexian Invasion provided the rats with a seemingly unlimited number of breeding grounds.

quotes.name: Loyal Sentry
quotes.flavor: "My cause is simple: To stop you, at any cost, from ever seeing the inside of this keep."

quotes.name: Lavaborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is disaster, painful and final."
—Matoc, lavamancer

quotes.name: Stonespeaker Crystal
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: It whispers words spoken centuries ago, coaxing wisdom from the ghosts of civilizations past.

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Privileged Position
quotes.flavor:
"We in the Conclave have a saying: 'When you hold a shield, lend your shield.' The strong must never forget what they owe to the weak."
— Niszka, Selesnya evangel

quotes.name: Somberwald Stag
quotes.flavor: Despite the reemergence of werewolves and the proliferation of Eldrazi, elk numbers in the Somberwald have remained steady.

quotes.name: Borderland Marauder
quotes.flavor: Though she is rightly feared, there are relatively few tales of her deeds in battle, for few survive her raids.

quotes.name: Utvara Hellkite
quotes.flavor: The fear of dragons is as old and as powerful as the fear of death itself.

quotes.name: Leafkin Avenger
quotes.flavor: "My roots are ash, my heart a smoldering ember. What I could not protect, I will avenge."

quotes.name: Trained Jackal
quotes.flavor: To taunt a man into action, call him a coward. To insult him beyond forgiveness, call him a jackal.

quotes.name: Warrior en-Kor
quotes.flavor: Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive Kor people.

quotes.name: Rivendell
quotes.flavor: Many desired to see the house of Elrond, and breathe the air of that deep valley where the Fair Folk dwelt in peace.

quotes.name: Ironscale Hydra
quotes.flavor:
"Put down your bows, you fools! Arrows only make it angry!"
—Callia, Hyrax Tower scout

quotes.name: Chrome Dome
quotes.flavor: "Broadcast: Seized. Initiate seek-and-destroy protocols."

quotes.name: Dreadbore
quotes.flavor: In Rakdos-controlled neighborhoods, everyone is part of the show.

quotes.name: Shimmerscale Drake
quotes.flavor: They are drawn by the brilliant blue glint of the mineral lazotep from the mines below.

quotes.name: Master Decoy
quotes.flavor: A skilled decoy can throw your enemies off your trail. A master decoy can survive to do it again.

quotes.name: Shed Weakness
quotes.flavor: To prepare for the Trial of Strength, nagas shed their old skin—and with it their scars, their doubts, and their fears.

quotes.name: Congregate
quotes.flavor:
"In the gathering there is strength for all who founder, renewal for all who languish, love for all who sing."
—*Song of All*, canto 642

quotes.name: Cinder Storm
quotes.flavor: Any pyromancer can summon fire with a thought. The trick is putting it out.

quotes.name: Drag the Canal
quotes.flavor: "Let's gather what we can before the Golgari tidy up the scene."

quotes.name: Wandering Musicians
quotes.flavor: "Even if you're lost, you can't lose the love because it's in your heart."

quotes.name: Mortify
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Your debt is erased."
—Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist

quotes.name: Armory Guard
quotes.flavor: The Dimir agents watched from the shadows. "Eight hours, and I've yet to see him blink," Nefara hissed. "I suggest we find another way in."

quotes.name: Icy Manipulator
quotes.flavor:
"The scavengers who first found it called it the 'Bone Crank.' Not a bad name, I'd say."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Freewind Falcon
quotes.flavor:
"That does it! I'm going back to hunting chickens!"
—Rhirhok, goblin archer

quotes.name: Veteran's Voice
quotes.flavor:
"Teach by example. If your students do not survive, they were not worth the lesson."
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Rite of the Dragoncaller
quotes.flavor: All at once, a quiet world was seized by wings, claws, fangs, and fire.

quotes.name: Malakir Familiar
quotes.flavor:
"They are deadly, and they are loyal. We can spare them a little blood."
—Harak, Malakir bloodwitch

quotes.name: Soldevi Digger
quotes.flavor:
"This ceaseless device has helped uncover marvels unreachable by mere flesh."
—Arcum Dagsson, Soldevi Machinist

quotes.name: Drana's Silencer
quotes.flavor: "Hush."

quotes.name: Phantom Wurm
quotes.flavor: It died with the forest, yet both linger on in twisted form.

quotes.name: Tranquil Expanse
quotes.flavor: Beyond the chaos of Ghirapur lies a vibrant world where aether flows through nature.

quotes.name: Sun-Crested Pterodon
quotes.flavor:
"Pterodons tolerate no intrusion into their skies. Even the clouds must ask permission."
—Mahuiz, Sun Empire archer

quotes.name: Soul Diviner
quotes.flavor: As the Eternal's cold fingers tightened around his throat, Domri realized what kind of master he had rushed to serve.

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.flavor:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

quotes.name: Unholy Heat
quotes.flavor: "The devils use fire. Why shouldn't we?"

quotes.name: Satyr Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

quotes.name: Ophiomancer
quotes.flavor:
"There are dark, ancient arts that fascinate even me."
—Sorin Markov

quotes.name: Xantcha
quotes.flavor: A Phyrexian "sleeper agent," Xantcha has developed an inviolate sense of self. This aberration earned her a death sentence, but she was rescued by Urza and joined his crusade. Her Phyrexian credo of "Waste not, want not" has helped Urza more than even he comprehends.

quotes.name: Bat Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "My little winged friends tell me which of these townsfolk are worth tasting for myself."

quotes.name: Taii Wakeen, Perfect Shot
quotes.flavor: "You'd best keep yourself out of my sights."

quotes.name: Akki Raider
quotes.flavor: Akki were very territorial, attacking and destroying any settlements that came too close to their mountain homes. The more successful their raids, the bolder they became.

quotes.name: Dream Coat
quotes.flavor:
"Adopt the character of the twisting octopus, which takes on the appearance of the nearby rock. Now follow in this direction, now turn a different hue."
—Theognis, *Elegies 1, 215*

quotes.name: Thrill of Possibility
quotes.flavor:
"Remember all the great heroes who were careful and never did anything risky? Me neither."
—Syr Carah, the Bold

quotes.name: Resuscitate
quotes.flavor:
"It is the art of convincing someone to live."
—Orim, Samite healer

quotes.name: Miss Demeanor
quotes.flavor: Even war can be civil.

quotes.name: Wandering Wolf
quotes.flavor: Humans still feared wolves, though no connection between them and the curse of lycanthropy had ever been proved.

quotes.name: Living Lightning
quotes.flavor: Not all storms come from the sky.

quotes.name: Reverberate
quotes.flavor: For every action, there is a swifter and more violent reaction.

quotes.name: Toxic Nim
quotes.flavor: The nim have become roving killers marshaled by whichever thane holds tenuous leadership.

quotes.name: Frontline Devastator
quotes.flavor: The God-Pharaoh's benevolence concealed the factory he created to produce an army of Eternals.

quotes.name: Serra Avenger
quotes.flavor:
"Those who endure in the face of suffering, those whose faith shines long in evil days, they shall see salvation."
—*Song of All*, canto 904

quotes.name: Shifting Wall
quotes.flavor:
"You'd almost think Volrath doesn't want me here."
—Gerrard

quotes.name: Dolmen Gate
quotes.flavor: "Stick close to Mama K."

quotes.name: Cloudsculpt Technician
quotes.flavor: A cloudsculptor at work is like a carefully balanced weather system, and just as dangerous to interfere with.

quotes.name: Chilling Trap
quotes.flavor:
"Serves you right for rushing ahead."
—Kaliea, Sea Gate trapfinder

quotes.name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: Its very presence rips old wounds open to bleed anew.

quotes.name: Gilt-Leaf Seer
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: Desmera blinded her seers so that her beauty would be the last image burned in their memories. The act only deepened their insight.

quotes.name: Dimir Cutpurse
quotes.flavor: Other guilds demand tolls from those who travel their territories, but not House Dimir. It takes its share secretly, one coin purse at a time.

quotes.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
quotes.flavor: Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.

quotes.name: Underground River
quotes.flavor:
"But stream and pool is wet and cool: so nice for feet! We only wish to catch a fish, so juicy-sweet!"
—Gollum

quotes.name: Dragon Whelp
quotes.flavor:
"O to be a dragon . . . of silkworm size or immense . . ."
—Marianne Moore, "O to Be a Dragon"

quotes.name: Coldsteel Heart
quotes.flavor: The Phyrexian death machine awoke, its coldsteel heart imbuing it with sinister new power.

quotes.name: Tegan Jovanka
quotes.flavor: "You certainly know how to fly this crate, don't you?"

quotes.name: One with the Machine
quotes.flavor: "Synth-kind welcomes you, as long as you welcome us."

quotes.name: Armageddon
quotes.flavor:
"Like my creator, I sought perfection. And just as he did, I found only sorrow."
—*End of Argentum: The Memoirs of Karn, Scion of Urza*

quotes.name: Summon: G.F. Cerberus
quotes.flavor: "Pretty confident. Let's see how you do."

quotes.name: Insight
quotes.flavor:
"We can fight with you or against you. After my day, I'd prefer the former."
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Fanatical Offering
quotes.flavor: The gateway could be opened only by the spilling of innocent blood. Vito did not hesitate.

quotes.name: Pet Avengers
quotes.flavor:
"Lockheed! Hairball! Lockjaw! Redwing! To me!"
—Throg

quotes.name: Grim Hireling
quotes.flavor: "This calls for a little redistribution of wealth."

quotes.name: Rain of Tears
quotes.flavor:
"When mortals die, they have family, friends, compatriots to mourn them. When the land dies, all else dies with it, and there is no one left to weep."
—Jacinth, Skyshroud ranger

quotes.name: Reflex Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"This sliver comes into the world a perfect predator. It's ready to hunt and devour its first meal within seconds of hatching."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Selesnya Cluestone
quotes.flavor:
"Break it if you must. The loss of one relic is nothing next to the value of enriching us all."
—Suniel the Woodwise

quotes.name: Craw Wurm
quotes.flavor: The most terrifying thing about the Craw Wurm is probably the horrible crashing sound it makes as it speeds through the forest. This noise is so loud it echoes through the trees and seems to come from all directions at once.

quotes.name: Monstrify
quotes.flavor: Gackt came to regret keeping his pet toads on his head.

quotes.name: Mutilate
quotes.flavor: "You mortals turn to dust in the blink of an eye. I only expedite your fate."

quotes.name: Gilded Lotus
quotes.flavor:
"The lotus is a potent but ephemeral source of power. To preserve its potency, lacquer carefully with a conductive coating."
—*Hurkyl's Metaphysics, vol. II*

quotes.name: Baron, Airship Kingdom
quotes.flavor: The advent of the airship marked the realization of Baron's dreams, but also the birth of its militarism.

quotes.name: Arbor Armament
quotes.flavor:
"Llanowar's boughs are ever ready
To unleash an autumn of steel leaves."
—"Song of Freyalise"

quotes.name: Challenger Troll
quotes.flavor: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

quotes.name: Reasonable Doubt
quotes.flavor: "Merle had the motive, but Blovinac was the one caught with the murder weapon. And who was the seven-foot-tall hooded figure? This case is a mess!"

quotes.name: Sengir Vampire
quotes.flavor: Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.

quotes.name: Lyzolda, the Blood Witch
quotes.flavor: Sacrificial rites take place before an audience of cheering cultists, each begging to be the next on stage.

quotes.name: Obscuring Haze
quotes.flavor:
"Toph, there's too many of them. We need an Earthbender. We need you."
—Katara

quotes.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
quotes.flavor: "The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."

quotes.name: Toxic Iguanar
quotes.flavor: There are no "weak" creatures on Jund. Even the smallest can strike a deadly blow.

quotes.name: Scholar of Stars
quotes.flavor: "The path of the stars is as reliable as the instruments that measure them."

quotes.name: Ogre Geargrabber
quotes.flavor: Long reach, short attention span.

quotes.name: Stonework Puma
quotes.flavor:
"We suffer uneasy ground, unstable alliances, and unpredictable magic. Something you can truly trust is worth more than a chest of gold."
—Nikou, Joraga bard

quotes.name: Rebuke
quotes.flavor:
"No one chooses to be stitched together into a skaab. If it could speak, it would beg for its own destruction."
—Thalia, Knight-Cathar

quotes.name: Mitotic Manipulation
quotes.flavor:
"They can't even comprehend nature. How could they improve it?"
—Venser

quotes.name: Scaled Wurm
quotes.flavor: The wurms become so big, a single scale can be used as a roof for a human dwelling.

quotes.name: Complaints Clerk
quotes.flavor: The longest lines in the park.

quotes.name: Mabel, Valley Hero
quotes.flavor: Mabel had learned that mother, adventurer, and protector were not all that far apart.

quotes.name: Evacuation
quotes.flavor:
"Once I supply the breeze, you'll see your warriors for the smoke they truly are."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

quotes.name: Brotherhood Regalia
quotes.flavor: An Assassin's best armor is not being seen.

quotes.name: Faithful Pikemaster
quotes.flavor: "I seek no fight with you, but neither will I stand aside."

quotes.name: Skyscribing
quotes.flavor:
"All clouds should be so organized."
—Isperia

quotes.name: Toxicrene
quotes.flavor: It emits a stinking cloud composed of millions of nascent microscopic organisms, each possessing a fragment of predatory sentience.

quotes.name: Citanul Hierophants
quotes.flavor: "All who inhabit these woods are part of our ritual, whether they realize it or not."

quotes.name: Desperate Castaways
quotes.flavor: A pirate crew without a ship is a crew that will do anything to get one.

quotes.name: Ecstatic Awakener // Awoken Demon
quotes.flavor: Bones cracked, flesh split apart, and the screams of euphoric agony gave way to unholy laughter.

quotes.name: Zombie Master
quotes.flavor: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

quotes.name: Magnify
quotes.flavor: The seed torches' pollen gives off light, but the elves find it heightens their senses as well.

quotes.name: Even the Score
quotes.flavor: Those who try to rob the Obscura often leave behind more than they take away.

quotes.name: Spara's Headquarters
quotes.flavor: To most, the Nido Sanctuary is an office complex. To the Brokers, it's a vault of secrets.

quotes.name: Frogmite
quotes.flavor: At first, vedalken observers thought blinkmoths naturally avoided certain places. Then they realized those places were frogmite feeding grounds.

quotes.name: Thran Golem
quotes.flavor: Even after thousands of years, the wondrous creations of the Thran guarded the lost empire's secrets with single-minded devotion.

quotes.name: Bladebrand
quotes.flavor:
"The pain of searing iron and razor edges pales beside the pleasure of performance."
—Judith

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Pyrokinesis
quotes.flavor:
"Anybody want some . . . *toast*?"
—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage

quotes.name: It That Heralds the End
quotes.flavor:
"At first we ignored the little ones. By the time we realized our error, it was too late."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Dancing Scimitar
quotes.flavor: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

quotes.name: Restoration Specialist
quotes.flavor: Dwarves' tools are priceless heirlooms handed down through generations.

quotes.name: Opportunist
quotes.flavor: The third time the Oracle glanced suspiciously at him, Starke decided she had glanced twice too often.

quotes.name: Stonehewer Giant
quotes.flavor: "No matter how strong, an unarmed fighter is no more than a fool."

quotes.name: Rhox Pikemaster
quotes.flavor: When the rhoxes charge, everyone else knows which way to run.

quotes.name: Dearly Departed
quotes.flavor:
"Never forget our ancestors. They have not forgotten us."
—Mikaeus, the Lunarch

quotes.name: Rakdos's Return
quotes.flavor: When Lord Rakdos stirred from his slumber, everyone else's nightmare began.

quotes.name: Augury Adept
quotes.flavor: Moonstones grant limited foresight but unlimited advantages.

quotes.name: Treespring Lorian
quotes.flavor: No matter your strength, the Krosan Forest is stronger. No matter your speed, the Wirewood Forest is faster.

quotes.name: Soul Swindler
quotes.flavor: "Three tries to decide your fate! Fabulous prizes! Probably no untold torment!"

quotes.name: Cold-Water Snapper
quotes.flavor: For generations, the inhabitants of Orvada have hungered for turtle soup. For generations, the turtles have frustrated their ambitions.

quotes.name: Flamewave Invoker
quotes.flavor: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

quotes.name: The Sibsig Ceremony
quotes.flavor: "Once flesh, now gold and jade. Once dead, now alive again. Once respected, now honored beyond imagination."

quotes.name: Mythos of Nethroi
quotes.flavor:
"And then the shadow took living form, and the shadow devoured the man whole—body, mind, and soul."
—*Tales of the Ozolith*

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: A spark of resistance against a tide of corruption.

quotes.name: Broadcast Rambler
quotes.flavor: Get the shot. Every time.

quotes.name: Control Magic
quotes.flavor:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Furnace of Rath
quotes.flavor: The furnace awaits the next master who would stoke the fires of apocalypse.

quotes.name: Beloved Princess
quotes.flavor: More remarkable than Miku's ability to open doors is her ability to open hearts.

quotes.name: Elephant Grass
quotes.flavor:
"How have I angered nature that she would imprison me in a labyrinth of grass?"
—Kasib ibn Naji, Letters

quotes.name: Rise of the Dark Realms
quotes.flavor: The empire expanded hungrily, every bloody conquest seeding the ground with the corpses of all who resisted. One moonless night, the corpses rose to take back what was theirs.

quotes.name: Psychic Corrosion
quotes.flavor:
"To break another's mind is to deliver a fate worse than death. It is a terrifying power."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Wellgabber Apothecary
quotes.flavor: "You've discovered that boggarts bite, I see. And will the militia be chasing this lot? . . . Ah, you're staying in town to avoid Nath's hunt. Wise. Now this poultice . . ."

quotes.name: Undead Warchief
quotes.flavor: It has the strength of seven men. In fact, it used to be seven men.

quotes.name: Thelon of Havenwood
quotes.flavor: "The sight of my thallids still thriving is a bittersweet welcome to this cold waste."

quotes.name: Thrun, the Last Troll
quotes.flavor: His crime was silence, and now he suffers it eternally.

quotes.name: Redwood Treefolk
quotes.flavor: The soldiers chopped and chopped, and still the great tree stood, frowning down at them.

quotes.name: Kindred Dominance
quotes.flavor: When the screams subsided, only the dry slither of scales and the hiss of cold breath remained.

quotes.name: Emeria Angel
quotes.flavor: When the earth shudders, the sky overflows.

quotes.name: Grave Titan
quotes.flavor: Death in form and function.

quotes.name: Levitation
quotes.flavor: Barrin's pride in his apprentice was diminished somewhat when he had to get the others back down.

quotes.name: Buried Ruin
quotes.flavor: History has buried its treasures deep.

quotes.name: Strict Proctor
quotes.flavor: "You might believe being dead for centuries has made me more lenient. I think you'll find the opposite to be true."

quotes.name: Wildsize
quotes.flavor: Two times the size, four times the smell.

quotes.name: Mindcrank
quotes.flavor: Domestication units channel the fury of a deathclaw to the Enclave's ends.

quotes.name: Carnassid
quotes.flavor: The hunter would never forget the time or place where he first met the carnassid, for they buried him there.

quotes.name: Beetleback Chief
quotes.flavor: Whether trained, ridden, or eaten, few goblin military innovations have rivaled the bug.

quotes.name: Gaea's Cradle
quotes.flavor: 2014 Legacy Championship Winner

quotes.name: Soothsayer Adept
quotes.flavor: One of the first lessons divination students learn is how to recognize the difference between a portent and a simple surface ripple.

quotes.name: Llanowar Knight
quotes.flavor: Her armor and steed were borrowed, but her courage was hers alone.

quotes.name: Spectral Sailor
quotes.flavor: "Permission to haunt aboard, cap'n?"

quotes.name: Ageless Guardian
quotes.flavor: Ancient ruins dot the world of Arcavios, most older than Strixhaven itself and many still guarded by soldiers from the Blood Age, centuries after their deaths.

quotes.name: Megatog
quotes.flavor: In an ironic bit of evolution, the megatog's dozens of teeth are mainly ornamental. It prefers swallowing things whole.

quotes.name: Spike-Tailed Ceratops
quotes.flavor: The conquistadors surrounded the dinosaur only to find that it had outflanked them.

quotes.name: Avalanche Tusker
quotes.flavor:
"Hold the high ground, then bring it to your enemy"
—Surrak, khan of the Temur

quotes.name: Blood-Chin Fanatic
quotes.flavor: "We are as brutal as our dragonlord. We strike like wild lightning and feast on human flesh."

quotes.name: Goblin Glider
quotes.flavor: The goblins call the gliders "death from above." Everyone else calls them "clods in the clouds."

quotes.name: Mountain
quotes.flavor:
3.
The day draws back, the time of struggle ebbs. Sun-scarred relics lie about the land.

quotes.name: Jetting Glasskite
quotes.flavor: The bolt struck with a flash, and there was a terrible sound, as of glass shattering, but the creature was unharmed.

quotes.name: Nykthos Paragon
quotes.flavor: Though Heliod turned against humanity in his hunger for power, the ideals he once championed still stand strong.

quotes.name: Alaborn Musketeer
quotes.flavor: Muskets gave the Alaborn army an advantage it had long lacked—air defense.

quotes.name: Archetype of Imagination
quotes.flavor:
"Is it not the embodiment of our aspirations?"
—Prokopios, astronomer of Meletis

quotes.name: Grave Strength
quotes.flavor: So long as death follows life, the supply lines of the Sultai will never be cut.

quotes.name: Brokers Ascendancy
quotes.flavor: "This is the beginning of a beautiful friendship. And more importantly, a profitable one. Now sign here."

quotes.name: Dwarven Nomad
quotes.flavor:
A dwarf's life belongs as much to the land as to the dwarf.
—Creed of the Stonethrow Clan

quotes.name: Wall of Reverence
quotes.flavor: The lives of elves are long, but their memories are longer. Even after death, they do not desert their homes.

quotes.name: Early Harvest
quotes.flavor:
"Earth's increase, foison plenty,
Barns and garners never empty:
Vines with clust'ring bunches growing;
Plants with goodly burden bowing."
—William Shakespeare, *The Tempest*

quotes.name: Brinebarrow Intruder
quotes.flavor: Locked in the ice of Karfell, the treasures of ancient nobles await in ruins guarded by the dead.

quotes.name: Buy Your Silence
quotes.flavor: Mikey "the Mouth" kept his nickname after he struck his deal with Gregorio, even though he never spoke another word.

quotes.name: Ingenious Leonin
quotes.flavor: Leonin claws were already deadly weapons of natural evolution before he improved upon them.

quotes.name: Relic Crush
quotes.flavor: There are many ruins, but there used to be many more.

quotes.name: Fade into Antiquity
quotes.flavor:
"Are the gods angry at our discontent with what they give us, or jealous that we made a thing they cannot?"
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

quotes.name: Chronosavant
quotes.flavor: "In my dreams, I hear the voices of my future selves who have died in times yet to come. I use that knowledge to avoid those dark futures and continue my search for peace."

quotes.name: Rumbling Sentry
quotes.flavor:
"To provoke the mountain is to invite the avalanche."
—Perisophia the philosopher

quotes.name: Dawnstrike Vanguard
quotes.flavor: "Arrive as the dawn, and banish night through your brilliance!"

quotes.name: Woolly Thoctar
quotes.flavor: One of the most ferocious and deadly gargantuans, the thoctar never sees its worshippers, but it often awakens surrounded by gifts and sacrifices.

quotes.name: Recurring Insight
quotes.flavor: On trial for sparing Galactus, Reed Richards found a cosmic truth and an unexpected ally.

quotes.name: Squirming Emergence
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Promos
quotes.flavor: Due to archaic Brazen Coalition guidelines regarding hats, a few mycoids are now technically pirate captains.

quotes.name: Xenosquirrels
quotes.flavor:
"Hey Glaxxar, did you remember to seal the vents on the seat belt control module?"
—Truss, chief engineer

quotes.name: Belbe's Armor
quotes.flavor: It protects her from the ravages of Phyrexia and the savages of Rath.

quotes.name: Baloth Woodcrasher
quotes.flavor: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

quotes.name: Fade into Antiquity
quotes.flavor:
"Are the gods angry at our discontent with what they give us, or jealous that we made a thing they cannot?"
—Kleon the Iron-Booted

quotes.name: Entish Restoration
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "Welcome to the Treegarth of Orthanc!"

quotes.name: Thornwood Falls
quotes.flavor:
"To Rivendell, where Elves yet dwell
In glades beneath the misty fell."
—Merry and Pippin

quotes.name: Priest of the Blood Rite
quotes.flavor: Some will sacrifice everything for but a taste of power.

quotes.name: Throatseeker
quotes.flavor:
"I just felt a drip. It must be about to rain."
—Stoneway Market vendor, last words

quotes.name: Sunlit Marsh
quotes.flavor: Even the poisoned land around the Stronghold blossomed with new life in the wake of the Great Mending.

quotes.name: Hand to Hand
quotes.flavor: The match between Tahngarth and Greven was close only in the mind of the minotaur.

quotes.name: Codie, Ravenous Codex
quotes.flavor: A font of knowledge for those able to read more than a page of hexed words.

quotes.name: Asylum Visitor
quotes.flavor: "The ravings of the mad are laced with eldritch knowledge."

quotes.name: Zodiac Rat
quotes.flavor: " . . . Cao Pi, Cao Rui, Fang, Mao, and briefly, Huan— / The Sima took the empire in their turn. . . ."

quotes.name: Canopy Spider
quotes.flavor: It keeps the upper reaches of the forest free of every menace . . . except for the spider itself.

quotes.name: Brushland
quotes.flavor:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Flutterfox
quotes.flavor:
"The white fox grinned. 'How about a bet, dragon? If I win, the skies are mine.' After he stopped laughing, the dragon agreed."
—*Tales of the Fae*

quotes.name: Talisman of Conviction
quotes.flavor:
"The sun banishes darkness every morning. I too will rise with such assuredness."
—Huatli

quotes.name: Topple the Statue
quotes.flavor: Bolas cared little when his statue fell, thinking it a useful distraction, underestimating the surge of resolve it gave his opponents.

quotes.name: Extrapolate the Impossible
quotes.flavor: Jace believed that if he could successfully merge the two Multiverses, he would remove the suffering of so many.

quotes.name: Sower of Temptation
quotes.flavor:
Moth to my light, cease resistance.
Hand over the reins to your mind.

quotes.name: Temporal Cleansing
quotes.flavor: Careless fae become lost in dreamstuff too sweet.

quotes.name: Staunch Defenders
quotes.flavor:
"Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!"
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Wall of Brambles
quotes.flavor: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

quotes.name: Fresh-Faced Recruit
quotes.flavor:
"Hold on to your ideals. They'll be tested more than your armor or the edge of your blade."
—Tajic

quotes.name: Elvish Spirit Guide
quotes.flavor:
"We are never without guidance, if we but seek it."
—Taaveti of Kelsinko, elvish hunter

quotes.name: Warstorm Surge
quotes.flavor: No fortification, however high, can protect those who provoke the ire of the molefolk.

quotes.name: Bushmeat Poacher
quotes.flavor: "If you've never feasted on Zagoth terror-pig, I got the best price you'll find."

quotes.name: Rabid Bite
quotes.flavor:
"You should have seen the look on *both* their faces."
—Morkamp, Lambholt innkeeper

quotes.name: Skyhunter Patrol
quotes.flavor:
"We leonin have come to rule the plains by taking to the skies."
—Raksha Golden Cub

quotes.name: The Sixth Doctor
quotes.flavor: "This is a situation that requires tact and finesse. Fortunately, I am blessed with both!"

quotes.name: Knights of Dol Amroth
quotes.flavor: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate.

quotes.name: Wolfbat
quotes.flavor: Wolfbats nest in tunnels carved out by badgermoles and hunt for prey in the dark caverns.

quotes.name: Vandalblast
quotes.flavor: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

quotes.name: Demon's Horn
quotes.flavor: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

quotes.name: Wings of Aesthir
quotes.flavor:
"For those of courage, even the sky holds no limit."
—Arnjlot Olasson, Sky Mage

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

quotes.name: Steam Blast
quotes.flavor: The viashino knew of the cracked pipes but deliberately left them unmended to bolster the rig's defenses.

quotes.name: Miracle Worker
quotes.flavor:
"Those blessed hands could bring surcease to even the most tainted soul."
—Sister Betje, *Miracles of the Saints*

quotes.name: Execute
quotes.flavor:
"Any fool who would die for honor is better off dead."
—Cabal Patriarch

quotes.name: Dimir Cutpurse
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor: Other guilds demand tolls from those who travel their territories, but not House Dimir. It takes its share secretly, one coin purse at a time.

quotes.name: Lunar Insight
quotes.flavor:
"When wolves howl at the moon, I can't help but wonder: Does it answer? What secrets might it share when humans aren't listening?"
—Elinor, philosopher

quotes.name: King's Assassin
quotes.flavor: Fear is as effective a weapon as the blade.

quotes.name: Goblin Recruiter
quotes.flavor: "Next!"

quotes.name: Lancer Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"These polearms were supposed to help!"
—Merrik Aidar, Benalish patrol

quotes.name: Beloved Princess
quotes.flavor: Sometimes a gentle slipper can travel where an armored boot's been denied.

quotes.name: Cephalid Looter
quotes.flavor: "Amazing, isn't it, what humans will throw away when they're drowning?"

quotes.name: Insidious Dreams
quotes.flavor: Chainer dreams of ultimate knowledge.

quotes.name: Pyromancer's Goggles
quotes.flavor: The strongest mentorships kindle the passions of both student and teacher.

quotes.name: Call for Unity
quotes.flavor: The "leaking spire" stands for liberation from Consulate control.

quotes.name: Hunter's Insight
quotes.flavor:
"The predator knows the true way of the world. Life is conflict. Only the strong survive."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Crumbling Necropolis
quotes.flavor:
"They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia. Now it is a blight, a place to be avoided by the living."
—Olcot, Rider of Joffik

quotes.name: Hobgoblin Bandit Lord
quotes.flavor: In a hobgoblin's view of the world, the weak owe tribute and fealty to the strong.

quotes.name: Cateran Kidnappers
quotes.flavor: Recruits aren't always volunteers.

quotes.name: Herald of Secret Streams
quotes.flavor: "You might as well try to stop the waterfall."

quotes.name: Hraesvelgr of the First Brood
quotes.flavor: "Never shall our grief be assuaged nor our loss forgotten."

quotes.name: Breeding Pool
quotes.flavor:
"Log 1.4.778: Granove, a tropical moon teeming with endemic biota. A must see for any aspiring astrobiologist!"
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

quotes.name: Soul Snuffers
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: They once sought to unite with the flame of transcendence. Now they seek only to extinguish the lights of others.

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

quotes.name: Geistlight Snare
quotes.flavor: Tamil had always wanted a closer look at a geist's lantern. Now he had an eternity to study one.

quotes.name: Yoked Ox
quotes.flavor: The courage of those who work the land is born of long days of labor in the hot summer sun and the cold winter wind. It is the courage of the earth itself.

quotes.name: Minotaur Sureshot
quotes.flavor: "Those wings are no advantage. I will pin them to the ceiling of the Hekma."

quotes.name: Ineffable Blessing
quotes.flavor: "Hallowed be this assemblage of various stuff!"

quotes.name: Fetid Pools
quotes.flavor:
"Whoever holds the Source controls the destiny of the planet."
—Cobb

quotes.name: Baleful Strix
quotes.flavor: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

quotes.name: Inspiring Vantage
quotes.flavor: "The Supreme Council has ordered our army to be activated immediately. The invasion of all solar planets is to begin today!"

quotes.name: Shamanic Revelation
quotes.flavor: First, whispers of ancient days. Then, visions of things to come.

quotes.name: Coal Golem
quotes.flavor: "Three such creatures stood burning at the crest of the hill. Only seconds later, the Fireball struck our front line." —Lydia, Countess Brellis

quotes.name: Norwood Ranger
quotes.flavor: Some trees bear deadly fruit.

quotes.name: Ascendant Evincar
quotes.flavor: His soul snared by an angel's curse, Crovax twisted heroism into its purest shadow.

quotes.name: Greed
quotes.flavor:
"There is no calamity greater than lavish desires.... And there is no greater disaster than greed."
—*Tao Tê Ching 46*

quotes.name: Furious Forebear
quotes.flavor:
"Your hatred dampens the land with my kin's blood. My love will flood it with yours."
—Hazena, spirit of House Emesh

quotes.name: Urza's Mine
quotes.flavor: Mines became common as cities during the days of the artificers.

quotes.name: Kaervek the Merciless
quotes.flavor:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

quotes.name: Immaculate Magistrate
quotes.flavor: Elves of the immaculate class weave flora into living creatures—sometimes to endorse an elite warrior, sometimes to create a breathing work of art.

quotes.name: Rodeo Pyromancers
quotes.flavor:
"My citizens throw good money at them, and for what? Cheap tricks and collateral damage. Damnable Slickshot charlatans."
—Baron Bertram Graywater

quotes.name: Modify Memory
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Percival's clothes itched and his dinner was unpleasantly wriggly, but the kobold looked like he was having the time of his life.

quotes.name: Fateful Handoff
quotes.flavor:
"Get the sylex to Urza at any cost. Tell him to fill it with memories of the land."
—Ashnod, to Tawnos

quotes.name: Koma, World-Eater
quotes.flavor: Some called him a monster. Others called him a god. All who beheld him knew his power.

quotes.name: Bladetusk Boar
quotes.flavor: Those who dare stand in its path are either brave or mindless. Or in the case of goblins, both.

quotes.name: Tether Technician
quotes.flavor: Konstrari cadets are Hexhaven's front line against any threat, be it Eradian abominations or extradimensional academies.

quotes.name: Unruly Catapult
quotes.flavor: An autonomous, self-loading catapult had seemed like such a good idea.

quotes.name: Prize Pig
quotes.flavor: The habit of building farmhouses and barns began among the inhabitants of the Marish down by the Brandywine.

quotes.name: Blightbeetle
quotes.flavor: Leaf and soul alike wither at its touch.

quotes.name: Drana, Kalastria Bloodchief
quotes.flavor: "If our former masters would have us kneel again, they shall feel our defiance slashed across their membranes."

quotes.name: Thresher Lizard
quotes.flavor: The sound of its plated tail beating on desert rocks is often mistaken for the footfalls of a much larger predator.

quotes.name: Pit Trap
quotes.flavor:
Never forget your feet
—Elvish expression meaning "watch your step"

quotes.name: Lightning Greaves
quotes.flavor: After lightning struck the cliffs, the ore became iron, the iron became steel, and the steel became greaves. The lightning never left.

quotes.name: Maestros Theater
quotes.flavor: Only extraordinary performers are invited to grace the grandest stage in New Capenna.

quotes.name: Jandor's Saddlebags
quotes.flavor: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

quotes.name: Mavren Fein, Dusk Apostle
quotes.flavor: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

quotes.name: Treva's Attendant
quotes.flavor: "Treva is the voice of the ur-dragon, demanding cries of worship."

quotes.name: Bristly Bill, Spine Sower
quotes.flavor: "Wake up, little ones. There's a new day ahead."

quotes.name: Catapult Fodder // Catapult Captain
quotes.flavor: And they're more than happy to share the wealth.

quotes.name: Faithless Looting
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

quotes.name: Shoot the Sheriff
quotes.flavor:
"Now, where is that deputy?"
—Jana, Hellspur thunderslinger

quotes.name: Dissection Practice
quotes.flavor: From the very first incision, Enid regretted choosing Witherbloom for her intercollege elective.

quotes.name: Your Fate Ends Here
quotes.flavor: "The future looms large over the present, and you're blocking my view."

quotes.name: Dusk Imp
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: Imps are just intelligent enough to have an understanding of cruelty.

quotes.name: Epic Confrontation
quotes.flavor: No matter the timeline, some legends will endure.

quotes.name: Ebony Owl Netsuke
quotes.flavor:
"Owls filled the skies during the Kami War, harbingers of darker times to come."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Curse of Shaken Faith
quotes.flavor: Even within the chapel's hallowed halls, the devils' laughter pierced his prayers.

quotes.name: Hydradoodle
quotes.flavor: Less housebroken than housebreaking.

quotes.name: Summoner's Sending
quotes.flavor: The sending takes them to the Farplane, where they may rest in peace.

quotes.name: Ash, Party Crasher
quotes.flavor: "Get up and dance! Let your feet thunder like forgehammers!"

quotes.name: Legacy Weapon
quotes.flavor: In a single blinding flash, Yawgmoth was obliterated, and Urza could finally rest.

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

quotes.name: Calamity Bearer
quotes.flavor: He'd ignite the World Tree itself if he could.

quotes.name: Team Tactics
quotes.flavor: "Most of my trick arrows don't talk this much."

quotes.name: Smoldering Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"Qo'noS is the only place in the quadrant a traveler can sample fifty-one varieties of *gagh*. Watch for *wistan gagh*, matured in *targ* blood."
—*Lawmim Galactopedia*

quotes.name: Grixis Panorama
quotes.flavor: There is no height above Grixis that is free from the stench of death.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Arena
quotes.flavor: An audience of one with the malice of thousands.

quotes.name: Elvish Archdruid
quotes.flavor:
"I sang of leaves, of leaves of gold, and leaves of gold there grew:
Of wind I sang, a wind there came and in the branches blew."

quotes.name: Weave Fate
quotes.flavor: Destiny is a flickering path among tangled possibilities.

quotes.name: Cataclysmic Prospecting
quotes.flavor:
"Now *that's* how you strike gold!"
—Jolene, plundering pugilist

quotes.name: Monstrous Growth
quotes.flavor: The nightstalkers' little game of tease-the-squirrel suddenly took an unexpected turn.

quotes.name: Nacatl Hunt-Pride
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Ajani vs. Nicol Bolas
quotes.flavor: "We must hunt and kill the dragon before it can return to raze our ancient city."

quotes.name: Dreadful Apathy
quotes.flavor: Those whose lives were uninspired are doomed to the wretched tedium of Phylias in death.

quotes.name: Run Away Together
quotes.flavor:
"Virtue is virtue, whatever the heart that nurtures it."
—Malacan, Vantress exile

quotes.name: I Delight in Your Convulsions
quotes.flavor: "I can't imagine what you're feeling right now, but I'll try my best."

quotes.name: Whirlwind Denial
quotes.flavor: "No, no, and ... no."

quotes.name: Masterwork of Ingenuity
quotes.flavor:
"The crucible yields what you have forged in your mind. You need only reach in and draw the masterwork forth."
—Wahara, Keeper of the Crucible

quotes.name: Nether Void
quotes.flavor: These days, some wizards are finding that they have a little too much spell left at the end of their mana.

quotes.name: Scuttlemutt
quotes.flavor: Built to shuttle goods from the river, it took off one day carrying a cauldron of dyes.

quotes.name: Enchantress's Presence
quotes.flavor: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

quotes.name: Python
quotes.flavor:
"How can you claim the gods are merciless when they robbed the snake of its limbs to give the other creatures a sporting chance?"
—Hakim, Loreweaver

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Follow the light. In its absence, follow her.

quotes.name: Ant-Man's Air Force
quotes.flavor:
"Cavalry incoming! Swat them if you dare!"
—Ant-Man, Hank Pym

quotes.name: Goldwardens' Gambit
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: At Neyali's command, they took position. At Otharri's signal, they struck.

quotes.name: Birds of Paradise
quotes.flavor: A single vivid feather fetches a royal price—but who, having seen these magnificent creations of Nature, would settle for a feather?

quotes.name: Peppersmoke
quotes.flavor: Like being trapped in a perpetual sneeze, faerie-dust poisoning is both exhilarating and agonizing.

quotes.name: An-Zerrin Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Fell the Mighty
quotes.flavor:
"There we sat high up above the floods and watched the drowning of Isengard."
—Pippin

quotes.name: Giant Adephage
quotes.flavor:
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

quotes.name: Auntie's Hovel
quotes.flavor: When they're feeling homesick, all the little goblins know where to go for a nice bowl of hot muck.

quotes.name: Horned Cheetah
quotes.flavor: "I think she wants us to eat it," said Squee, staring at the oily carcass the cheetah had dragged to their fire.

quotes.name: Whisper, Blood Liturgist
quotes.flavor: "Look how they beg for the knife! The Demonlord has trained them well."

quotes.name: Koma's Faithful
quotes.flavor: "Great Serpent, hear my song! We wait, our faith unshaken, for your glorious return."

quotes.name: Vessel of Malignity
quotes.flavor: From within its prison, the book endlessly whispers words of cruelty and spite.

quotes.name: Run Aground
quotes.flavor:
"That's the first time I've seen the ground do the running."
—Captain Brinely Rage

quotes.name: Patchwork Banner
quotes.flavor: With thistle, quill, twig, and beak, the finest artisans of each animalfolk society stitched unique quilts, patched together as a symbol of harmony.

quotes.name: Call of the Conclave
quotes.flavor: Centaurs are sent to evangelize in Gruul territories where words of war speak louder than prayers of peace.

quotes.name: Pradesh Gypsies
quotes.flavor:
"A mysterious people indeed. Their origins are as secret as their traditions."
—Lord Magnus of Llanowar

quotes.name: Wiccan, Rising Magician
quotes.flavor: "Step outside of reality for a moment. It might improve your attitude."

quotes.name: Vanish from Sight
quotes.flavor: The Wanderer flung out her hand, but too late—Kaito had vanished into the House's maw.

quotes.name: Hot Springs
quotes.flavor: Warmth is life; heat is peace.

quotes.name: Kindred Discovery
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Few things are truly "lost" at sea.

quotes.name: Canopy Vista
quotes.flavor: The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.

quotes.name: Festercreep
quotes.flavor: A single festercreep isn't alone. It's already an infestation.

quotes.name: Radiant Grove
quotes.flavor:
"You're not really going to see the dead, more like your memories of them. They take on the form of the dead person—an illusion, nothing else."
—Rikku

quotes.name: Jandor's Saddlebags
quotes.flavor: Each day of their journey, Jandor opened the saddlebags and found them full of mutton, quinces, cheese, date rolls, wine, and all manner of delicious and satisfying foods.

quotes.name: Fleshbag Marauder
quotes.flavor: Grixis is a world where the only things found in abundance are death and decay. Corpses, whole or in part, are the standard currency among necromancers and demons.

quotes.name: Golden-Tail Disciple
quotes.flavor: Students of the kitsune-led Golden-Tail Academy in Eiganjo are unparalleled in both martial skill and dedication to the Imperial cause.

quotes.name: Sunblast Angel
quotes.flavor: There may exist powers even greater than Phyrexia.

quotes.name: Feldon of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: "She will come back to me."

quotes.name: Mandroid Squadron
quotes.flavor: The Avengers have extraordinary powers and abilities. Mandroid armor lets S.H.I.E.L.D. even the score.

quotes.name: Barbed Sliver
quotes.flavor: Spans of spines leapt from one sliver to the next, forming a deadly hedge around the *Weatherlight*.

quotes.name: Serendib Efreet
quotes.flavor: Summoners of efreeti remember only the power of command, never the sting of regret.

quotes.name: Topan Ascetic
quotes.flavor: Monks from Topa wander all of Bant, encouraging the Unbeholden to find their place in society through honorable combat.

quotes.name: Storm of Souls
quotes.flavor: Devotion does not end with death.

quotes.name: Brain Gorgers
quotes.flavor: In spite of their hunger, they're slow eaters.

quotes.name: Elvish Visionary
quotes.flavor: Before any major undertaking, a Cylian elf seeks the guidance of a visionary to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

quotes.name: Xande, Dark Mage
quotes.flavor: "But your struggle was all for naught. Don't you see how close the darkness has drawn?"

quotes.name: Slice and Dice
quotes.flavor: Tahngarth relished the chance to bloody his blades on those who had ravaged his home.

quotes.name: Young Necromancer
quotes.flavor: "Who needs imaginary friends when you've got dead ones?"

quotes.name: Slimy Piper
quotes.flavor: All throughout the glade, sprouts squelched happily along to the tune.

quotes.name: Gilded Lotus
quotes.flavor: Over such beauty, wars are fought. With such power, wars are won.

quotes.name: Basilica Bell-Haunt
quotes.flavor: You can hear their tolling only when your debt is due.

quotes.name: Ruination
quotes.flavor:
"We have built a wall upon sand. The wall will vanish. The sand will remain."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Hunting Drake
quotes.flavor: Even the fiercest beast will flee when faced with the possibility of becoming dinner.

quotes.name: Arming Gala
quotes.flavor: For the Cabaretti, everything is a party.

quotes.name: Universal Automaton
quotes.flavor:
"Within minutes, the strange device was indistinguishable from the other upon my workbench."
—Tocasia, journal entry

quotes.name: Streetwise Negotiator
quotes.flavor: Like the laws, the rules of engagement always seem to bend in the Brokers' favor.

quotes.name: Obsianus Golem
quotes.flavor:
"The foot stone is connected to the ankle stone, the ankle stone is connected to the leg stone..."
—Song of the Artificer

quotes.name: Fires of Yavimaya
quotes.flavor: Yavimaya lights the quickest path to battle.

quotes.name: Whir of Invention
quotes.flavor: "Magic hat, I'm gonna be frank. What we need now is a twenty-ton tank!"

quotes.name: Kujar Seedsculptor
quotes.flavor: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

quotes.name: Recoil
quotes.flavor: Anything sent into a plagued world is bound to come back infected.

quotes.name: Browbeat
quotes.flavor:
"Even the threat of power has power."
—Jeska, warrior adept

quotes.name: _____ Bird Gets the Worm
quotes.flavor: It's not like anyone else really wanted it.

quotes.name: Phantom Monster
quotes.flavor:
"While, like a ghastly rapid river,
Through the pale door,
A hideous throng rush out forever,
And laugh—but smile no more."
—Edgar Allan Poe, "The Haunted Palace"

quotes.name: Lava Axe
quotes.flavor: Meant to cut through the body and burn straight to the soul.

quotes.name: Crushing Canopy
quotes.flavor:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa

quotes.name: Dread Return
quotes.flavor: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

quotes.name: Arachnogenesis
quotes.flavor: Every movement is a summons—even your screams.

quotes.name: Maja, Bretagard Protector
quotes.flavor: "Our enemies have breached our realm. To survive, the clans must fight as one!"

quotes.name: Tideshaper Mystic
quotes.flavor: He paints with drop and shimmer a world that exists only in the wistful heart.

quotes.name: Bull Cerodon
quotes.flavor: It holds motionless vigil, watching Naya in silence through the screen of the whitecover. When it senses anything amiss, it launches forward with the uncanny sound of torn fog.

quotes.name: Tradewind Rider
quotes.flavor: It is said that the wind will blow the world past if you wait long enough.

quotes.name: Shape the Sands
quotes.flavor:
"Dragons in flight seldom expect company."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Tempest of Light
quotes.flavor: "Let everything return to its true nature, so that destiny may take its course."

quotes.name: Selvala, Explorer Returned
quotes.flavor: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

quotes.name: Vampire of the Dire Moon
quotes.flavor: "This place suits me: craven authorities and plentiful prey."

quotes.name: Shanna, Purifying Blade
quotes.flavor: Shanna had heard Sisay's legend all her life. Now it was time to forge her own.

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor: Radioactive fog was the least of the inhabitants' worries.

quotes.name: Volcanic Fallout
quotes.flavor:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

quotes.name: Warpath Ghoul
quotes.flavor: Ghouls are often found skulking on the fringes of great battles, showing themselves only to snatch the wounded and weak, dragging their victims screaming into the shadows.

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"We are all decaying, always in a state of near-death. One moment without breath and we begin to break down."
—Cevraya, Golgari shaman

quotes.name: Vedalken Orrery
quotes.flavor: The model incorporated the fifth sun effortlessly, as if it had always known.

quotes.name: Belligerent Whiptail
quotes.flavor:
"Whiptails can sense a traveler's footsteps from a great distance. Measuring that distance has been . . . difficult."
—Jalun, Affa sentry
